ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this I day of December (this “"Agreement"), between Avenue, Suite 900, New York, New York 10170 ("Seller") and FIFTH AT 42ND LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 565 Fifth Avenue, 14th Floor, New York,New York 10017 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. Seller is the owner of certain land known by the street address 509 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 72 in Block 1277 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to as "Seller's Land,” and said improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being herein referred to as “Seller's Building,”" and Seller's Land and Seller's Building being herein referred to as"Seller'sProperty"). B. Developer is the owner of certain lands adjacent to Seller's Land, known by the street addresses 503 Fifth Avenue,505 Fifth Avenue and 507 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lots 1, 2 and 4 respectively in Block 1277 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to collectively as “Developer's Existing Building"). C.Developer may renovate Developer's Existing Building or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new or thereof or additions theretowhether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to collectively as “Developer's Proposed Building" and Developer's Land, Developer's Existing Building and Developer's Proposed Building being herein referred to collectively as"Developer'sProperty").
